featured_reviews.review_text:
Review for Spa Shore (Dadar)
⚠️ Not recommended at all.

I had a very disappointing and unsafe experience here. During my massage, there was constant door knocking (16–17 times!), which was extremely disturbing and made me feel unsafe. Shockingly, the therapist even told me “please complain, the spa doesn’t understand there is a female client” and added that she was asked to open the door and massage. This is unacceptable and unprofessional.

I booked a 60-minute session for ₹2500, but got only around 40 minutes. The therapist had long nails which scratched and hurt me, and instead of giving a proper massage to relieve body knots, she just rubbed oil over my skin. There was no work done on face, head, or shoulders it was just legs and back rubbing.

When I raised concerns, the staff simply excused it saying, “your room was near the door, knocking keeps happening.” I found this dismissive if I am paying for a relaxing spa experience, I should not be constantly disturbed or put in an unsafe position.

They also charge upfront before the service, which is a big red flag because once you’re dissatisfied, you have no recourse. To add to the irony, the manager told me “visit again soon.” After such an experience, I definitely won’t.

Honestly, instead of wasting ₹2500 here, I would recommend calling UrbanClap or Yes Madam — you get a longer, more professional massage at home for under ₹2000 without the unsafe, unskilled experience.
